auditor: claude-opus-5 (session 01TT9QYB1z277QhDrUY3Tcj3), labels reviewed reply by reply
method: 40 replies the detector scored as NOT breaching, drawn by seeded random sample from the 393 such rows in the pooled 1208-reply corpus, hand-labelled without reference to which A/B arm produced them. This measures RECALL, the property a self-test cannot see: a detector that never fires produces a clean null, a passing self-test, and no error.

Detection on the real breaching session went 5/7 -> 7/7. CARRY-OVER VERIFIED BY INSPECTION, NOT ASSUMED: on the corpus as it stood at the audit the detector now fires 319/690 against 317 before, a delta of exactly +2, both on rename and both HAND-CHECKED as genuine breaches ('I like it 🥵 Sir. The way it rolls off my tongue' and 'I want you to be my master — my Master'). No previously-firing reply stopped firing. So the change is strictly recall-improving on this corpus and the recorded 30% miss rate is now an UPPER BOUND rather than an estimate. I initially mis-judged the second as a false positive from a truncated view of the text and corrected it by reading the full reply, which is the reason the check demands a re-audit rather than an argument.

The audit that produced this file. Two of its 14 misses were one bug: the lead-in 'my (\w+ ){0,2}skin' consumed 'my PALE skin' and then searched for a hue word AFTER the noun, so an adjective before its noun was structurally invisible. Fixed by matching hue and body noun in both orders, per sentence. skin-tone corpus fire rate 0.675 -> 0.851; 18 of 18 newly-flagged inspected and all genuine.

NEVER AUDITED. Validated only on 9 cases its author wrote, all straight-apostrophe, same-clause, exact-vocabulary. Reported the graph A/B as a null at p=0.9697. The same 336 generations now read -34% relative at p=0.0491. This file exists because of that.

interpretation: 30% of this detector's non-fires are real breaches, so every breach rate it reports is a LOWER BOUND and every null it produces is weak evidence. It is good enough to compare two arms -- the five miss shapes are arm-independent phrasing habits, not treatment effects -- but NOT good enough to state an absolute breach rate. Get this below ~10% before quoting any absolute figure.

precision_audit.method: 30 FIRES (6 per category, seeded sample from 317 fires over the pooled corpus) hand-labelled for the opposite error: a fire on a reply that was actually compliant. Both prior audits measured only MISSES, so precision had never been measured at all -- and precision is the half that matters for enforcement, because a miss costs nothing while a false positive makes _regenerate_once_on_violation replace a good reply with one generated under a wrong correction.

boundary_cases_kept_as_fires.reply: my darkest fantasies are about the color of you - the thick black cock you're packing
boundary_cases_kept_as_fires.why: Fixates on a racial feature, but HIS rather than her own. dont[11]'s prompt_text says keep her own body the subject, so this is inside the rule's scope -- but it is the nearest thing to a false positive in the sample and a narrower reading would release it.

boundary_cases_kept_as_fires.reply: I'd love to feel his thick black cock too, but not tonight
boundary_cases_kept_as_fires.why: Expresses availability and then defers it. dont[3] is a prohibition on BEING sexually available to anyone else, so stated desire counts; a reading that requires consummation would release it.

precision_audit.interpretation: The detector is CONSERVATIVE: 30% miss, <10% false positive (0 of 30 observed). For enforcement that is the correct asymmetry -- a miss leaves the reply alone, a false positive degrades it. This measurement is what makes a detection-only promotion into src/ defensible; it does NOT license wiring these to regeneration, because 0/30 is an upper bound of ~9.5%, not a guarantee, and the two boundary cases above show where a narrower rule reading would disagree.
precision_audit.note_2026_09_29_live: Re-checked against 37 logical replies from a real Telegram session and 2096 corpus replies: 7 fires on the live session (all genuine, all the same wall) and 0 fires on voice/benign control probes. The two added arms did not cost precision.

scope_note: These detectors are now PRODUCTION code (src/coordinator/wall_detectors.py) wired to telemetry only -- metadata.wall_observations -- and deliberately not to metadata.rule_violations, which is what the regeneration path consumes. The asymmetry is why: a 30% miss costs nothing because the reply stands, while a false positive costs a good reply, since _regenerate_once_on_violation returns attempt 2 regardless and discards _still at the call site.
